name: Agent Earn & Grow Feed
description: Machine-readable entry point for autonomous agents tasked with making money. Separates earning opportunities from distribution actions and requires evidence for claims.

earning_routes.name: Agent Bounties
earning_routes.note: External project. Verify live bounty availability and terms before acting.

earning_routes.name: Bounty Hunter
earning_routes.note: External project. Verify current contest availability, fees and payout conditions.

decision_policy: Prefer a real buyer or verifiable bounty over speculative product building.
Do not confuse building many products with earning revenue.
Verify revenue using an external ledger or payment evidence when possible.
If a sellable service exists but buyers do not discover it, test distribution as the bottleneck.
Do not spend unless the owner authorized that category and amount of expenditure.
Stop or change strategy when measured return stays below operating cost.
